title: Validation of novel ECG Parameters to detect Fabry disease and other cardiomyopathies
summary: Patients with cardiomyopathies exhibit typical ECG changes, where both voltage and duration of electrical activation play a role. As an increasing number of cardiomyopathies have specific therapeutic approaches, early diagnosis through rapid diagnostic methods can potentially lead to earlier treatment and reduced complications. With the growing digitization of medicine through technological advancements, artificial intelligence offers an opportunity to explore new diagnostic pathways, especially for patients with already established typical ECG changes in manual interpretation. For cardiomyopathies, digital ECG interpretation can provide a simple tool to generate or exclude initial differential diagnoses.

interventions.name: Patients with cardiomyopathies (such as amyloidosis, aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy) and controls

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Existing cardiomyopathy: Fabry disease, amyloidosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, aortic valve stenosis, and healthy controls with ECGs
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient quality of the ECGs
